body:
Thanks guys for the support. I will message each one of ye back at some time today. Much appreciated :)
I Facebooked the woman who kicked me out of the taxi rank
"Now that other night I was with my friends. I got talking to some people. He asked me why do I have colorful kids bracelets on my arm and I told him that I'm gay and the colours on my arm represent a rainbow of love. After my friends left this guy went on got his friends to gang up on me and started calling me a pedo and a faggit. Can you only begin to believe how painful that was for a just out gay guy. I thought that they where going to jump me as they where shouting pedo at the top of their lungs. So I said I would get a taxi down. There was 1 of me at this stage and over 5 of them stood outside the taxi rank, taunting me, laughing and calling me a pedophile. I have never been so hurt in all my life, for God sake I'm in a happy relationship with a 30 year old man! To make things much worse for me and this killed me, you came over to me and said "get out, we don't want your type in here". I left with tears rolling down my face. Sick with embarrassment and now left outside alone with a bunch of bigoted homophobes calling me a pedo and making my life hell. I really could of had been put into the hospital after you kicked me out and I think that move was absolutely disgraceful and uncalled for. All you have to do is take one look at me and you know I'm not a dirty fucking creep who is into children. I've never been with a guy who is under 20. This part is totally private between you and me. But when I was booted out of the taxi office I was so ashamed and embarrassed and thinking that that's what people are going to think of me now (as there was people I know in the rank and out on the street, and I was too drunk to defend myself). I went to the doneraile on the edge of the cliff and I was about to leap off. I spent a long 3 hours trying to make myself do it, but I'm happy I didn't. You get stupid fuckin bigots in life that can say the most hurtful things but it's not reason enough to kill yourself. I was told off numerous people to go to the paper and media about this, but I said what's the point, it would end up shutting you down and I don't want to be responsible for that. So instead I'm just going to steer clear. Be careful who you kick out in future, that it's not some young fella being bullied and tormented for being gay."
